Definition: Dizahab, a place in the Desert
BiblicalUsage: Dizahab was a place in the wilderness on the border of Moab, named in the opening verse of Deuteronomy as Moses spoke to all Israel. The name means enough gold.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the wilderness places are named because God met His people there, and the journey mattered as much as the destination.
